name: weaver
description: ebrAIn.lab Weaver monorepo. Workspace-level scripts only.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-markdown && npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-github && npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-cli && npm run compile -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-vscode-extension
scripts.check: npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-markdown && npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-github && npm run build -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-cli && npm run check -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-vscode-extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-markdown && npm run test -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-github && npm run test -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-cli
scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/dev.js examples/sample-workspace
scripts.dev:docs: npm run build && node scripts/dev.js docs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-vscode-extension
scripts.package:cli: npm run build && npm run bundle -w @ebrain-lab/weaver-cli
scripts.dev:overview: npm run build && node scripts/dev.js examples/overview.code-workspace
